name: Metal Container Corporation - Windsor CO Can Plant

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single truck driveway off the south public road (Eastman Park Dr area) is a wide open paved driveway with a yellow sign post on the median - no barrier arm, sliding gate, guard booth, or checkpoint. Street View Oct 2025 confirms open access; the driveway curves up into the property toward the building with no internal gate visible.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the entrance in satellite or Street View Oct 2025.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate exists, so no remote check-in.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The gate-to-dock driveway is long - it curves up roughly 200+ m from the south road through the property to the building's truck apron, with ample queue room.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Manufacturing plant (~105,000 sq ft, ~2B cans/yr, ~100 workers) with a modest dock count - roughly 6-8 dock doors counted at the NE corner of the building at zoom 20; estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No dedicated marked trailer-storage lot observed; the east apron is a paved truck-circulation/staging area, not a drop yard. Only ~2 trailers visible in imagery.
fieldNotes.railServed: A single rail line runs N-S immediately east of the property but it is a corridor/through-line; no spur enters the MCC building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Facility sits among open farmland and scattered industrial buildings on the edge of Windsor, CO - clearly Rural.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: East paved apron could hold ~10-12 trailers if used for staging; low-confidence estimate.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single connected structure - a windowless warehouse/storage section (north) joined to a process-equipment-laden manufacturing section (south).
